description: RAPID/GEER Phase 2 Reconnaissance Mission: Western European Floods Summer 2021 is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Michael Gardner, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). This project documents flood-induced geo-structural damage and geomorphological change due to the flooding in the Ahr Valley in Germany during the 2021 Western European floods. It contains detailed, multi-instrument measurements both within the river channel and along the river banks at five carefully selected sites. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Flood, Foundation Damage, Scour, Erosion, Bridge Collapse. Published 2023-08-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
